title: ReadinessScoreV1
description: Deterministic Windows on Arm readiness score produced by the ARM Migration Assist scorer (Feature 2). Consumed by the AI Migration Planner as read-only input. The MigrationPlanV1.scoreDigest field is the lowercase SHA-256 of the canonical JSON serialization (RFC 8785 JCS) of this document; canonicalization is how tampering is detected. Cross-record rules JSON Schema cannot express (dimension weightPct summing to 100, uncapped >= final, cap ceiling honoured, evidenceId resolution against the source assessment, presence of all five dimension keys) are enforced by the scorer and by the plan validator.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version tag. Accepts 1.x minor versions. Unsupported majors are rejected.

assessmentId.description: The RepositoryAssessmentV1.assessmentId this score was produced from. Byte-identical match is enforced by the plan validator.

generatedAt.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 UTC timestamp when the score was produced.

producer.description: Metadata about the scorer that produced this document. Recorded in the audit log for reproducibility.

overallScore.description: Final readiness score after caps and deductions, in the closed interval [0, 100].

uncappedScore.$comment: overallScore <= uncappedScore is enforced by the scorer and validator, not by JSON Schema.
uncappedScore.description: Weighted sum before caps are applied. Equal to overallScore when no cap fires.

band.description: Banded readiness classification. 'insufficient-evidence' is required when provisional AND coverage is too low to place a band.

evidenceCompleteness.description: Banded evidence-completeness label. Independent of readiness. Renamed from 'confidence' in scoring-v2 to disambiguate from MigrationPlanV1.confidence.

evidenceCompletenessScore.$comment: Numeric precision should stay at 2 decimal places for canonicalization stability.
evidenceCompletenessScore.description: Raw evidence-completeness in the closed interval [0.0, 1.0] before banding.

provisional.description: true when scan coverage or scanner failures prevent a fully-supported readiness call.

provisionalReasons.description: Zero or more reasons why the score is provisional. Empty when provisional is false.

dimensions.$comment: Cross-record rules: exactly one entry per dimensionKey; sum of weightPct = 100; sum of weightedContribution approximates uncappedScore.
dimensions.description: Per-dimension breakdown. Exactly five entries, one per DimensionKey.

capsApplied.description: Blocker caps that fired, in order of application. Empty when no cap fired.

majorBlockers.description: Named blockers that the score exposes for the planner to reason over.

rationaleCodes.description: Aggregate rationale codes emitted by the scorer, deduplicated across dimensions.

rationaleDescriptions.description: Map from rationale code to a one-line human description. Includes an entry for every code that appears anywhere in the score. Codes without a curated description use the code string itself as description.

scoreSummary.description: Deterministic one-paragraph summary of the score, safe for the planner model to lift into MigrationPlanV1.scoreInterpretation.

evidenceIds.description: All evidence IDs the scorer touched, deduplicated. The plan validator uses this list to check that every evidenceId in the plan is drawn from evidence the scorer actually observed.

EvidenceId.description: References an evidence record in the source RepositoryAssessmentV1. Resolution is enforced by the evidence validator.

DimensionKey.description: Closed enum of the five scored dimensions.

CapId.description: Closed enum of known blocker caps.

BlockerCategory.description: Which subsystem a major blocker belongs to.

ruleset.description: Scoring ruleset identifier (weights + deductions + cap thresholds) in effect. Must be stable per corpus/ruleset revision.

DimensionScore.description: Score for one of the five dimensions.

weightPct.$comment: Sum of weightPct across all five dimensions must be 100. Enforced by the scorer/validator.
weightPct.description: Percentage weight this dimension contributes to the uncapped score.

rawScore.description: Dimension raw score after per-dimension formula and deductions, in [0, 100].

weightedContribution.description: rawScore * weightPct / 100. Two decimal places recommended for canonicalization.

confidence.description: Dimension confidence in [0.0, 1.0]. Rolled up (weighted mean) into top-level confidenceScore.

Deduction.description: One deduction applied while computing a dimension's raw score.

magnitude.description: Points subtracted (non-negative). Applied to the dimension's raw score.

CapApplication.$comment: overallScore <= ceiling is enforced by the scorer/validator.

ceiling.description: Maximum final score allowed by this cap.

triggeredBy.description: Evidence IDs that caused this cap to fire.

MajorBlocker.description: Named blocker exposed to the planner as a first-class citizen for reasoning and reporting.
